showcase.user_prompt: 刚才改了哪些文件？让我看看具体差异。
showcase.assistant_reply: Git 面板会展示暂存、未暂存和未跟踪文件；选中文件即可展开对应 diff。

blocks.title: 项目内的 Git 工作台

items.title: 暂存与提交
items.description: 分区查看暂存/未暂存/冲突，右键暂存、丢弃，面板内直接提交。

items.title: AI 写提交信息
items.description: 一键按项目规范生成提交信息，不新建会话，生成后仍可手改。

items.title: 变更状态树
items.description: 按目录查看已修改、新增、删除、重命名和未跟踪文件。

items.title: 内联 Diff
items.description: 点击文件直接查看工作区相对 HEAD 的差异。

items.title: 提交图
items.description: 浏览提交历史，并按本地或远程分支筛选。

items.title: 同步仓库
items.description: 在面板中执行获取、拉取、推送和同步。

showcase.user_prompt: Which files changed? Show me the actual differences.
showcase.assistant_reply: The Git panel shows staged, unstaged, and untracked files. Select one to expand its diff.

blocks.title: A Git workspace inside your project

items.title: Stage and commit
items.description: Staged, unstaged and conflicting files in separate lists; stage, discard and commit without leaving the panel.

items.title: AI commit messages
items.description: Draft a message from the project's own rules in one click — no new conversation, and still editable.

items.title: Change tree
items.description: Browse modified, added, deleted, renamed, and untracked files by folder.

items.title: Inline diffs
items.description: Inspect workspace changes against HEAD without leaving the panel.

items.title: Commit graph
items.description: Browse history and filter by local or remote branches.

items.title: Repository sync
items.description: Fetch, pull, push, and sync from the panel.
